meaning: 昆虫作为食物的优势理由
usageNote: 这是个短语组合，说话时可拆开用！聊环保或未来食物话题时超实用，显得你很有见识～

examples.en: There are many reasons why insects are good food options, including their high protein content and low environmental impact.
examples.zh: 昆虫是优质食物来源的理由很多，包括高蛋白质含量和对环境的低影响。

examples.en: One of the main reasons why insects are good food options is that they require far less water and land than traditional livestock.
examples.zh: 昆虫成为优质食物选择的主要原因之一，是它们比传统牲畜需要少得多的水和土地。
